legalDisclosure: Our ventures are brands, products, and initiatives under common ownership, not a representation of separate incorporated subsidiaries. No government agency or homeowners association sponsors or endorses GovernUp Solutions or its ventures.

ventures.name: The Westphalia Gazette
ventures.description: Independent local journalism serving Westphalia in the Upper Marlboro area of Prince George’s County, Maryland.
ventures.detail: Founded September 11, 2026, The Westphalia Gazette covers development, traffic and transportation, local news, business, and community life. It is GovernUp’s current flagship growth priority, with a distinct identity and a commitment to sustained local reporting.
offerings: Editorial standards, attribution, and corrections procedures
ventures.disclosure: The Gazette’s news coverage is not controlled by the commercial, professional, civic, or personal interests of its publisher or affiliated ventures. Corporate ownership does not determine editorial direction.

ventures.name: Covenant
ventures.description: Software that brings resident communication, board work, and association administration into one accessible platform.
ventures.detail: Covenant is available to prospective communities and clients. Its tools support the everyday work of homeowners associations, from organizing documents and service requests to managing board and resident workflows. Features vary by plan; consult the product website for current availability.
offerings: Resident and board dashboards, announcements, and documents
Online voting, violation tracking, and architectural review workflows
ventures.disclosure: Covenant is a software product of GovernUp Solutions, LLC. Product availability does not imply an established customer base or a management relationship with any association.

ventures.name: Covenant Management Partners
ventures.description: Governance-focused community association management and advisory services rooted in local understanding.
ventures.detail: Covenant Management Partners (CMP) is available to prospective associations. Its current signature offering, the Governance Health Check, helps boards understand their records, processes, and operational priorities. The venture grew from firsthand board experience and an interest in representation and community understanding within association management.
offerings: Governance Health Check and readiness assessment
Written findings, board presentation, and action roadmap
ventures.disclosure: CMP is a trade name of GovernUp Solutions, LLC. Its advisory services are not legal or accounting advice. The founder’s board service does not establish a CMP management contract with that association.

ventures.name: VotePG.org
ventures.description: Independent, nonpartisan tools that make local election information easier to find and understand.
ventures.detail: VotePG helps Prince George’s County residents locate district-specific election and candidate information. Created in response to the difficulty of finding local election resources in one place, the platform was publicly available during the 2026 primary period and is intended to support relevant election cycles.
offerings: Links and resources to support informed voting
ventures.disclosure: VotePG is an independent civic-information initiative under GovernUp ownership. It does not endorse candidates, political parties, or ballot positions and is not an official election authority. Verify voting requirements with official election sources.
